proof_body:
by
  have hc30 : Irrational (Real.cos (Real.pi / 6)) := by
    rw [Real.cos_pi_div_six]
    have h3 : Irrational (Real.sqrt 3) := by
      have : Irrational (Real.sqrt ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := irrational_sqrt_natCast_iff.mpr (by norm_num)
      simpa using this
    simpa using h3.div_natCast (m := 2) (by norm_num)
  have key : ∀ θ : ℝ, (∃ q : ℚ, Real.cos θ = q) → ∀ n : ℕ,
      (∃ q : ℚ, Real.cos (n * θ) = q) ∧ (∃ q : ℚ, Real.cos ((n + 1) * θ) = q) := by
    intro θ ⟨c, hc⟩ n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact ⟨⟨1, by simp⟩, ⟨c, by simpa using hc⟩⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨⟨b, by push_cast; exact hb⟩, ⟨2 * c * b - a, ?_⟩⟩
      have e1 : ((k : ℝ) + 1 + 1) * θ = ((k : ℝ) + 1) * θ + θ := by ring
      have e2 : (k : ℝ) * θ = ((k : ℝ) + 1) * θ - θ := by ring
      have h1 := Real.cos_add (((k : ℝ) + 1) * θ) θ
      have h2 := Real.cos_sub (((k : ℝ) + 1) * θ) θ
      rw [← e2] at h2
      push_cast
      rw [e1, h1]
      rw [hb, hc] at h1 ⊢
      rw [hb, hc, ha] at h2
      rw [ha] at *
      linarith
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
    apply hc30
    have hc2 : ∃ q : ℚ, Real.cos (2 * (Real.pi / 180)) = q := by
      refine ⟨1 - 2 * s ^ 2, ?_⟩
      have := Real.cos_two_mul (Real.pi / 180)
      have h1 := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (Real.pi / 180)
      rw [← hs] at *
      push_cast
      rw [← hs]
      nlinarith
    obtain ⟨⟨q, hq⟩, _⟩ := key _ hc2 15
    refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
    rw [← hq]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    apply hc30
    obtain ⟨⟨q, hq⟩, _⟩ := key (Real.pi / 180) ⟨c, hc.symm⟩ 30
    refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
    rw [← hq]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
